what_area_is_about: prefetching data into cache before navigation
prefetch staleTime versus mounted useQuery staleTime
initialData as real starting cache data
why cached data can still refetch on mount
key_ideas: Prefetching improves perceived performance but does not guarantee zero loading UI.
Prefetch staleTime controls the prefetch decision, not automatically the mounted useQuery freshness.
Mounted useQuery may refetch prefetched data if its own staleTime is 0.
initialData is cached but can be stale immediately by default.
initialData is skipped when the query key already has cached data.
placeholderData keeps UI stable while real query data is loading.
